How to Use & Tips - HTML to PDF

2Professional & Security Tips

What is HTML to PDF?

The HTML to PDF tool is the most convenient way to save web pages as permanent PDF documents. Whether you want to turn a live website, local HTML files, or web-based reporting dashboards into a printable format, this tool captures the webpage exactly as it appears in your browser. It is absolutely perfect for offline reading or digital archiving.

100% Private & Secure

We process everything directly on your local device. Because TacoPDF renders the HTML content locally, you can safely convert private intranets or confidential corporate reports without fearing that your code or data will leak to the internet. We never upload your web content to our external servers.

Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Will the layout and visual styling remain exactly the same?
A: Yes, our tool utilizes your browser's native rendering engine to accurately capture CSS styles, modern fonts, and complex layouts, so the resulting PDF matches the original webpage beautifully.

Q: Can I convert offline HTML files that contain local images?
A: Yes! As long as the HTML file and its referenced images are located in the same folder and can be opened normally in your web browser, our tool can convert them into a PDF without any issues.
